messages:
anya: Observability alert: hourly rollup for sessions_active undercounts vs raw by ~10% at 2025-01-14T02:00 UTC. Likely missing spans during shard handover.

ben: can you share the sample diff?

anya: sample: rollup.sessions_hourly (2025-01-14T02:00) expected=12,340 actual=11,109. Logs show commit timeout on shard-3 around 02:03.

carmen: shard-3 has had repeated task restarts after the autoscaler tweak. This smells like a timing window where commits get dropped.

drew: propose three actions: hotfix guard to surface commit failures (owner: ben, ETA 6h), audit autoscaler config (owner: carmen, ETA 48h), and a backfill playbook + dashboard card (owner: anya, ETA 24h).

ops-bot: reminder: include runbook entry when closing tasks.

ben: Ill take the hotfix. Plan: increment commit_failure metric and raise an alert if >0 for 5m. Will canary on shard-3.

anya: updated tracker: hotfix assigned to ben, audit to carmen, playbook to anya. Scheduling follow-up check-in tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

carmen: starting autoscaler audit now, will post findings.

ben: PR posted: github.com/redwood/etl/pull/1288 (commit-guard). Canary stable after 20m, no more missing spans on shard-3. Rolling out.

anya: thanks team. Closing thread; reopen if delta resurfaces.
